item.title: Manu Bhaker Secures Silver for India at the 2026 Asian Shooting Championship
item.description: GUWAHATI: Olympic double bronze medallist Manu Bhaker suffered a heartbreakingly close defeat but still shone bright at the Asian Rifle/Pistol Championship in New Delhi on Monday, 9 February, clinching silver in the women’s 25m pistol after a tense shoot-off. Vietnam’s Nguyen Thuy Trang held her nerve in the tie-breaker to secure gold after both shooters were locked at 35 points at the end of regulation.
